225-2645-3430-3861.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1021-5414-6303-6763.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat.

1563-2457-6441-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1368-4359-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4359-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5223-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
3259-5223-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

814-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

433-1362-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-1362-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

129-2113-3812.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-2113-3812.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2079-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
2079-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2292-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2893-3470-4826-5455.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-1409-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}, choosing its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any of the other three modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trgger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ashling's Command.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, causing you to create two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 3.

1482-2438-2866-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

549-4050-4694-5544-6757.description:
Cast Forsaken Miner by paying {B}.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token.
The Munitions token enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its ability, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Munitions abilities, dealing infinite damage to opponents and/or permanents opponents control.

4616-5641-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4616-5641-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1365-1651-4659-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-4659-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

1274-3197-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-6719.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2499-4124-5954-6664.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

440-1339-4050-5070.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4050-5070.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-1939-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1939-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

907-1479-1659.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-1659.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-2457-4094-5794.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1308-2457-4094-5794.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

181-2105-3263-4836.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least two opponents.
181-2105-3263-4836.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant's myriad and printed abilities trigger.
Resolve the myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, not exiling the Combat Celebrant tokens due to The Master.
Repeat using a Combat Celebrant token that hasn't attacked this turn.

856-1201-1636-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Witch's Oven does not have summoning sickness.
Ensoul Artifact attached to Witch's Oven.
856-1201-1636-4832.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familar enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1365-2744-4404-5256.notablePrerequisites: Corridor Monitor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2744-4404-5256.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Corridor Monitor's power.
Repeat.

1636-2034-2666-4343.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to cause a white creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1636-2034-2666-4343.description:
Cause a white creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Intruder Alarm and Court Street Denizen trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the white creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Court Street Denizen trigger, tapping an opponent's creature.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 4/4 Elemental creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Elemental tokens.

1284-1729-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Shelob.
Shelob does not have summoning sickness.
1284-1729-4762.description:
Activate Shelob by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Devoted Druid that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

702-1580-2825-4067-4411.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that can produce {B}.
You are about to lose the game.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
702-1580-2825-4067-4411.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {4} and tapping it, casting and resolving a copy of Stunning Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Let the event that would cause you to lose happen, but instead draw seven cards and set your life total to 1.
Activate Mind Over Matter seven times by discarding seven cards, untapping Elite Arcanist and six lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {5}{B}.
Activate Jinxed Ring by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
Jinxed Ring triggers.
In response, activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {4} and tapping it, casting and resolving a copy of Stunning Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Let the Jinxed Ring trigger resolve, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat from step 2 until there are fewer than seven cards remaining in your library.
Resolve all Jinxed Ring abilities, causing an opponent to gain control of Jinxed Ring.
